case.summary: The case involved four online purchases on card C12641-K2 totaling $1,922.43, each just under a $500 authorization limit and occurring within 36 minutes. The investigation found the pattern matched a known coordinated scheme that had appeared on 11 other cards, and the card had been previously linked to fraud. The case was escalated to a fraud analyst, who confirmed the coordinated nature of the activity. The card was blocked, pending authorizations were declined, connected cards were monitored, a report was filed, and the case remains open for further review.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-29 19:00 and 2016-11-29 19:36, card C12641-K2 held by customer C12641 was used for 4 online transaction(s) totalling $1,922.43 (transaction IDs 3497982, 3498004, 3498051, 3498092). The activity came to the bank's attention through an analyst request on 2016-11-29 19:36:00, referring to transaction 3498092 for $484.48. The transactions were billed in region code(s) 143, 436 (country code 87 unless noted), and the purchaser email domain was sbcglobal.net. Online activity used the device profile Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1440x900; SM-G930V Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome generic for android | 1920x1080. The activity fits none of the bank's five documented fraud patterns. Authorization-threshold structuring: 4 online purchases on one card, each between $400 and $500, inside about 36 minutes, from more than one device. The amounts look chosen to stay just under a $500 authorization limit. The same run shape appears on 11 other cards in the surrounding weeks, so it is a repeated scheme across customers rather than one compromised card. The same scheme links to other cards, which have been placed under monitoring: C00466-K1, C01890-K1, C02265-K1, C03633-K1, C05423-K1, C05766-K1, C05851-K1, C06881-K1, C07297-K1, C10751-K1, C10990-K1. Analyst confirms the repeated under-$500 run shape links 11 other cards with the same activity in the window and agrees it is one coordinated scheme. The card has been recommended for blocking and reissue, and the total suspicious amount reported is $1,922.43.
